metadata.title: Multi-Class Fruit and Vegetable Detection Dataset for Computer Vision
metadata.description:
This dataset contains 20216 annotated images of 30 fruit and vegetable categories, and 222301 annotations. All images are annotated in YOLO format. 

The dataset includes training, validation, and test splits.

The dataset is composed of the following datasets publicly available on the Roboflow platform: 

  • Tomato Detection (mhqnr) (\url{https://universe.roboflow.com/sanjeevani-tiwari-ko8gl/tomato-detection-mhqnr})
